4 The following section shall be inserted after section 9—
“9A Orders before preparatory hearing.

(1) Subsection (2) below applies where—
(a) a judge orders a preparatory hearing, and
(b) he decides that any order which could be made under section 9(4)
or (5) above at the hearing should be made before the hearing.

(2) In such a case—
(a) he may make any such order before the hearing (or at the hearing),
and
(b) subsections (4) to (10) of section 9 above shall apply accordingly.”

5 The following section shall be substituted for section 10 (later stages of trial)—
“10 Later stages of trial.

(1) Any party may depart from the case he disclosed in pursuance of a
requirement imposed under section 9 above.
